title: Email/import and Email/copy: BackendSetError::Other causes early exit, loses partial batch results
description: email.rs:840 (import) and email.rs:1026 (copy): BackendSetError::Other triggers 'return Err(JmapError::server_fail(...))'. This discards all previously collected created/notCreated entries and returns a top-level invocation error. RFC 8621 §5.7 allows partial success in batch operations. If 3 emails are imported and the 3rd fails with a storage error, the client receives an invocation error with no record of the 2 that succeeded. Fix: handle Other errors as per-item serverFail entries in not_created, consistent with the email.rs create/update/destroy loops.
